name: Driftsun Durashell Rigid Stand Up Paddleboard 10.5ft SUP, with Paddle, Fin, and Leash
description: RIGID DURASHELL PADDLEBOARD. Super tough polycarbonate outer shell with an ultra-smooth seamless finish and EPS Core. The Driftsun Hard paddle board offers the same benefits as a traditional Hard Fiberglass SUP but with the Confidence of a very strong Outer Shell. Worry less about dings, dents or cracks. LIGHTWEIGHT & COMFORTABLE. Uncompromising durability in one lightweight package - The Hard SUP weighs in at only 29 Lbs. Equipped with EVA foam traction pad, its slip resistant and comfortable on the feet for long paddles. SPECS and FEATURES. All your paddling needs covered in one package: 10.5 x 32" x 4.75" High Impact Board, 10Ft. Coil leash, Nylon Center Tracking Fin, and Heavy-Duty 3-Piece Adjustable Delta ASUP Paddle. Perfect for recreational paddling, fishing, surfing, or water yoga. ANY SKILL LEVEL OR CONDITION. Outfitted with forward Adjustable Bungee Storage Deck for Quick and Easy Access to Extra Gear. Great for All Skill Levels & Conditions, Freshwater or Saltwater. Built for any Adventure, Bring your Dog, Cooler or a Friend with you. GUARANTEE ON WORKMANSHIP & MATERIALS - All Driftsun Stand-up Paddleboards come with a 1 Year Guarantee on materials, workmanship, and assembly Details and Features Complete Package Includes: Hard SUP, 10 ft. Leash, Nylon Center Fin, and Adjustable Paddle Length: 10.5 FT Width: 32 Inches Thickness: 4.75 Inches Weight: 29 LBS Capacity: 250 lbs Pad: EVA Foam Adjustable 2 Piece Aluminium Delta ASUP Adjustable Paddle with Nylon blade 12 Month Warranty This board has multiple mounting options for your leash. Leash can be attached at the handle or at the rear of the board. Poised to outlast your wildest water adventures. Driftsun introduces its toughest Stand-up Paddleboard yet. Made with a super strong outer shell and EPS core, the Driftsun 10.5 ft Hard SUP paddle board earned its name for a reason.
